fields.statement: The owner monitors Rhiza from a browser: the daemon serves a read-only web UI on localhost, designed from the owner's Claude Design system, showing the daemon and its health, live and recent runs, the inbox and the roadmap of milestones and change sets, kept live without reloading.

With the daemon running, the owner opens http://127.0.0.1:7787 (through their own port forward) and sees the daemon and its health, live runs and their current step, what waits in the inbox, and each milestone's change sets, without a terminal.
Nothing the web UI serves writes: only allowlisted read operations of internal/api are reachable, it binds only to 127.0.0.1, and turning it off (rhiza.web.port off) leaves the daemon as it was.
Every page follows the design system Claude Design produced from the owner's basics, in a dark and a light theme, with its fonts embedded so pages load nothing from the network.
An open page shows a run's step move, an inbox item arrive or a change set land within a few seconds, without a reload.
make check is green, rhiza check included, read commands stay within their budget, the binary needs no Node or other build toolchain, and the default test run binds no socket.

fields.quote: This will run as part of the daemon process and be served on localhost. The user will be responsible for any port forwarding (if it's running on this VM for instance). First pass will be read only. For monitoring purposes only and we will build from there.
fields.statement: The first web UI is served by the daemon process on localhost, read-only and for monitoring only; the owner handles any port forwarding.

fields.quote: The first requirement will be to obtain a design. You will generate a prompt that I will then feed to Claude design to generate a design system.
fields.statement: The web UI's design comes first: the agent writes a prompt, the owner feeds it to Claude Design, and the design system it produces is what the pages are built on.

fields.quote: Motifs: fine glowing hyphae threads, small typed nodes (filled dot = intent, ring = capability, diamond = decision, square = constraint), always-dark terminals, pill buttons, 12–16px radii, thin 1px rules. No gradients, no emoji.
fields.statement: The design system starts from the owner's basics: dark-first 'bioluminescent soil', Petrona, Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono, the soil and paper palettes with fungal gold, teal and rose accents, typed node glyphs, always-dark terminals, 12-16px radii, 1px rules, no gradients, no emoji.
The daemon serves a read-only web UI on localhost for monitoring Rhiza: the daemon, runs, the inbox and the roadmap.
